independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the offset, arrow, popup padding, radius, gap and width cap.

intent: Show interactive content (a form, settings, details with actions) anchored to the control that opened it, without leaving the page

properties.description: Whether the popup is shown. Setting it (attribute or property) fires no openchange and moves no focus; an interaction sets it unless openchange is canceled.
Open at first connect when no open attribute is present (Base UI defaultOpen).
Never opens; presses, hover and focus on the trigger do nothing.

Preferred side of the trigger (Base UI Positioner side): top, bottom, left or right; empty for the default (bottom). The popup flips to the opposite side when there is no room; data-side says where it is.
Alignment along that side (Base UI Positioner align): start, center or end; empty for the default (center).
With open-on-hover: open after the pointer rests this long on the trigger, in ms (Base UI delay); default 300.
With open-on-hover: close this long after the pointer leaves trigger and popup, in ms (Base UI closeDelay); default 0.
Trap focus inside the popup while open (Base UI modal); the popup gets aria-modal. Focus leaving does not close it.
Also open when the pointer rests on the trigger for delay ms, and close after close-delay once it leaves (Base UI Trigger openOnHover). A popover opened by a press stays until dismissed.
Text of the generated ui-button trigger (the preset form), read at first connect. Ignored when a [data-part=trigger] is authored.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between the popup's children in u (0…8 in 0.5 steps); default the group gap (1u).

events.name: openchange
events.trigger: an interaction opens or closes the popup: a trigger press, an outside press, Escape, focus leaving, a Close part or hover; preventDefault keeps it as it is

semantics.role: none on the host; the popup is role=dialog (aria-modal when modal), labelled by its title and described by its description; the trigger has aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded and aria-controls

keyboard.action: toggle the popup; opening moves focus to its first focusable element
close the topmost popup and return focus to the trigger
move through the popup; leaving it closes a non-modal popover, a modal one keeps focus inside

sources: the trigger's text (label or authored trigger content)

content.children: Popup content (any elements; [data-part=title], [data-part=description] and [data-part=close] among them), or authored [data-part=trigger] and [data-part=popup] children. A [data-part=arrow] in the popup draws the arrow.

constraints: The host takes no box (display: contents): the trigger lays out where the host is written.
The popup stays in the DOM while closed (the positioner is a hidden manual popover) and paints in the top layer while open, above every z-index and outside overflow clipping.
Focus moves into the popup only when a press opens it; opening by setting open or by hover leaves focus where it is.
Setting open from script shows or hides the popup without an openchange event.

avoidWhen.when: A short text hint for a control, shown on hover or focus.
avoidWhen.reason: A tooltip describes its trigger (aria-describedby) and holds no interactive content.

avoidWhen.when: A list of commands or choices the user picks one of.
avoidWhen.reason: A menu gives roving focus and item semantics; a select picks a form value.

avoidWhen.when: A task that blocks the page until it is done.
avoidWhen.reason: A dialog is centered and modal over a backdrop; a popover belongs to its trigger.

nodes.summary: The element that opens the popup (a generated ui-button, or any authored element; a plain one becomes role=button): aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, aria-controls, data-popup-open while open. Base UI Popover.Trigger.
The floating layer (popover=manual, in the top layer while open), placed 1u from the trigger; data-side / data-align and Base UI's positioner variables. Base UI Popover.Positioner.
The surface (role=dialog): a card-sm with the reveal motion; scrolls when the space runs out. Base UI Popover.Popup.
Optional triangle on the popup's edge facing the trigger, centered on it (data-uncentered when it cannot be). Base UI Popover.Arrow.
Optional heading that names the popup (aria-labelledby). Base UI Popover.Title.
Optional text that describes the popup (aria-describedby). Base UI Popover.Description.
Optional element whose press closes the popup (reason close-press). Base UI Popover.Close.
